notes.title: Patch Notes: V0.1.4
notes.notes: [h3][b]Changes:[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Ranked Points Optimization[/b]: Climbing ranks is now smoother in higher tiers.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Early Exit Penalty Adjustment[/b]: Improved handling of ranked points when players quit mid-match.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Low-Tier Matchmaking[/b]: Enhanced gameplay experience for entry-level ranks.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3][olist][*][p][b]Shop Relic Preview[/b]: Fixed display bugs during pre-purchase.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Progress Loss Prevention[/b]: Resolved Steam save corruption upon abnormal game closure.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fame System[/b]: Fame progress now persists between matches (no longer reset).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Story Unlocks[/b]: Character and faction stories can now be properly unlocked.[/p][/*][/olist]
